key_insight: Knowledge Fusion Network (KFN) reduces catastrophic forgetting by adding novelty-gated capacity instead of repeatedly overwriting shared parameters.
engineering_relevance: KFN could support sequential updates to engineering AI models while preserving prior capabilities, but solid-mechanics applications are not evaluated here.
method: Learn each incoming task in an isolated 2.8M-parameter specialist network.
Fuse specialists into the global model using novelty-conditioned channel allocation.
Protect consolidated knowledge with channel separation and phased gradient unfreezing.
evidence_signal: On Split CIFAR-100 and EuroSAT, reported class-incremental retention is 72.7% and 42.5%, versus best-baseline values of 29.6% and 0.94%; ten-task model size is 28.1M parameters versus 112.0M for naive backbone duplication.
watch_item: Capacity still grows with incoming tasks, and substantial forgetting remains: 57.92% on ten-task Split CIFAR-100.
paper_title: Learning without Overwriting: Structural Knowledge Fusion for Continual Learning
